name: badge
title: Badge
description: A compact status or label chip. 3 variants × semantic colors × 4 sizes, with dot, loading, and icon support.

meta.whenToUse: Label or annotate status, counts, or categories — e.g. Active, Beta, 3 New.
meta.whenNotToUse: Anything clickable — use a Button; a Badge is a non-interactive label.
